tool_input.description: Read API signature digest and search core for token/throttle support

result: Personal API tokens are in place: users create and revoke named tokens on the profile page, and bearer-authenticated `GET` and `POST /api/posts` work with a 60-requests-per-minute limit per token. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (10 tests, including the new `tests/ApiTokens.test.ts`, which covers creation, hashed storage, 422s, 401s on bad or revoked tokens, ownership 404s, and the 429 with `Retry-After`). The changes are in `db/schema.ts` and a new migration under `db/migrations/20261018231930_add_api_tokens/`, which I applied to both the dev and test databases. The token logic is built on the framework's `@guren/core` token store, bearer middleware, and rate limiter, so only the secret's SHA-256 hash is persisted. Token endpoints are in `app/Http/Controllers/ProfileController.ts` and `routes/auth.ts`, the API is in `app/Http/Controllers/Api/PostApiController.ts` and `routes/api.ts` (mounted from `routes/web.ts`), and the profile UI is in `resources/js/pages/profile/Edit.tsx`. I did not exercise the profile UI in a browser, so that part is verified only by typecheck. Generated `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated, and nothing is committed.
